examples.title: Storefront — system context
examples.readerQuestion: Who talks to the storefront platform, and which outside systems does it depend on?
examples.whenAppropriate: C4-style context views without internal services.
examples.layoutPolicy: TD stack; person → system → externals row; compact; groupAccent false
assumptions: One logical commerce platform at context level
Warehouse and email providers are unnamed externals
Stripe is the only named payment vendor

examples.title: Order fulfillment — from checkout to warehouse
examples.readerQuestion: What happens after a customer places an order?
examples.whenAppropriate: Container-level architecture with team ownership and sync vs event edges.
examples.layoutPolicy: LR Checkout|Events|Consumers; compact; orthogonal; groupAccent false; named animations
assumptions: Retry timing omitted; DLQ destination shown

examples.title: Order service — ports and adapters
examples.readerQuestion: How do inbound and outbound adapters surround the order application core?
examples.whenAppropriate: Hexagonal / ports-and-adapters overview for one service.
examples.layoutPolicy: Outer hex row (driving|service surround|driven); nested Application hex + Domain; spacious; groupAccent true
assumptions: CreateOrderCommand is the inbound port; adapters map into it
OrderRepositoryPort is owned by the core; Postgres and in-memory implement it
Inventory and notifications are out of scope for this hexagon

examples.title: OrderPlaced — event consumers
examples.readerQuestion: Who consumes OrderPlaced and where do exhausted deliveries go?
examples.layoutPolicy: LR Publish|Backbone|Consumers; compact; => for events; groupAccent false
assumptions: Publisher shown as outbox relay plus topic only

examples.title: Order fulfillment — interaction
examples.readerQuestion: In what order do checkout, publish, and consumers interact?
examples.whenAppropriate: Sequence / interaction timing for the fulfillment path.
examples.layoutPolicy: sequence with autonumber, parallel consumers, named animations
assumptions: No Temporal or other orchestrator product

examples.title: Order lifecycle
examples.readerQuestion: Which order statuses are legal and which transitions move between them?
examples.whenAppropriate: First-class state diagram for lifecycle legality.
examples.layoutPolicy: state surface; LR compact; illustrative guards in labels
assumptions: Ship completes fulfillment without modeling warehouse scans

examples.title: Customer refund request
examples.readerQuestion: How does a refund request move through eligibility, inspection, approval, and payout?
examples.whenAppropriate: Business workflow with decisions and swimlane ownership.
examples.layoutPolicy: TD swimlanes; orthogonal; compact; groupAccent false; deny animation

examples.title: Checkout schema
examples.readerQuestion: Which tables own checkout data and how do foreign keys relate them?
examples.whenAppropriate: ERD / persistence model for checkout entities.
examples.layoutPolicy: LR flat tables; compact; orthogonal FK crow’s-feet; groupAccent false
assumptions: Outbox table omitted from this ERD

examples.title: Order fulfillment — review slide
examples.readerQuestion: Same fulfillment story with review chrome and named animations.
examples.whenAppropriate: Presentation / design-review export of a correct architecture graph.
examples.layoutPolicy: Same topology as order-fulfillment; light theme; metro; groupAccent false

examples.title: Language atlas — kinds and edges
examples.readerQuestion: What kinds, content knobs, and edge operators does the language expose?
examples.whenAppropriate: Language catalog — not a system map.
examples.layoutPolicy: TD compact grid of packed catalogs; groupAccent false

examples.title: Geometry kinds
examples.readerQuestion: What geometry kinds and aliases are available?
examples.whenAppropriate: Shape catalog — not a system map.
examples.layoutPolicy: LR 2-column packed shape catalog; groupAccent false

examples.title: Architecture icons
examples.readerQuestion: How do Lucide, logos, and simple-icons appear on architecture nodes?
examples.whenAppropriate: Icon catalog — not a system map.
examples.layoutPolicy: TD 2-column icon packs; no fake topology edges; groupAccent false
